title: docs(adr-0021): mark Phase 2 accepted & closed
body:
Marks ADR-0021 **Accepted & shipped — Phase 2 closed 2026-06-10**, now that the single-form cutover ([#1676](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/1676)) and the spec-major changeset ([#1677](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/1677)) are merged.

### Changes
- **Status line** → Accepted & shipped, referencing the cutover + 9.0.0.
- New **"Implementation status"** close-out section:
  - Documents the actual **dual-form → reconcile → single-form** delivery shape (the reconciliation gate proved `old == new` before the inline form was deleted) vs. the original one-shot big-bang posture.
  - Per-workstream **WS0–WS5** status table.
  - Downstream verification: in-repo green (build 72/72, test 123/123, spec 6526/6526); hotcrm + 10 templates packages **36/36 artifacts** valid against 9.0.0.
  - **Deferred follow-ups** called out honestly: cross-object joins + D-C RLS hardening (no shipped dataset exercises a relationship join yet), conformed dimensions, and the 9.0.0 publish + sibling `^9.0.0` bump.

Docs-only.
